summary.headline: Q4 FY26 revenue rose 22% YoY to INR5,252M but missed expectations on two large clients' budget pullbacks; FY27 guided to high single-digit growth.
summary.overview: Q4 FY26 revenue was INR5,252M, up 5% QoQ and 22% YoY (14% YoY in constant currency), with acquisitions MST and SweetRush contributing. Management said revenue came in below expectations because a couple of large clients made transient but material cuts to year-end L&D budgets amid macro uncertainty. FY26 revenue was INR19,520M (+18.1% YoY), EBITDA INR3,957M at a 20.3% margin, and PAT INR2,477M (+9%). FY27 guidance is high single-digit revenue growth and 18-20% EBITDA margin, with 18% in Q1 FY27, and management guided only for FY27 on the back of longer decision cycles.

segments.name: Technology and telecom
segments.commentary: Sharp QoQ growth drop attributed to one large client pulling back L&D budget at its fiscal year-end; management called it temporary and expects restoration in Q1 FY27.

segments.name: AI-enabled business
segments.commentary: Approximately 13% of revenue in Q4, up from about 11% in Q3 FY26; management says the share keeps rising.

segments.name: MST (DACH region)
segments.commentary: Acquired around July 2025; added a new annuity client and a significant scope expansion in Q4, with early cross-sell.

segments.name: SweetRush
segments.commentary: Completed early Q4 FY26; expanded with a top 20 global pharma client. Seasonally weakest quarter; margins to build over about 6 quarters, with EPS accretion from FY27.

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue growth guided to high single digits, inclusive of SweetRush and MST, subject to the macro environment; guidance limited to FY27 only.
FY27 EBITDA margin guided at 18-20%, with 18% expected in Q1 FY27 given investments and phased SweetRush margin build.
Q1 FY27 growth: management said double-digit YoY is achievable, with low single-digit QoQ growth implied for Q1.
SweetRush EPS accretion expected from FY27; margin build over approximately 6 quarters.
Management reiterated a traditional 20% margin profile and does not expect that to change in the near future.
capex_capacity: Headcount kept lean; growth delivered more through contractors, which raised outsourcing costs as management cited uncertainty.
Over 100 senior AI learning and science experts engaged in building AI solutions and products.
AI learning practice building a three-part platform: AI Coach, simulation manager and signal engine.
Continued investment in AI capability, consulting and advisory, and go-to-market for wallet share expansion.
demand_pricing: Client decision cycles are elongated and discretionary spend is scrutinized; management expects this to slow new ramp-ups near term.
Pipeline described as robust, with large outsourcing deals across technology, automotive, life sciences and BFSI.
Management cited net revenue retention as strong but gave no numeric NRR; said it would be a new metric shared going forward.
FY26 growth: existing clients +4% organic constant currency; new clients about 3%; inorganic about 3-4%.
Pricing: component-level pricing model for AI offerings with natural expansion economics; lighthouse deployments under validation.
Top 5 clients each above USD10M revenue in FY26; next 8 clients each USD5-10M.

qa_highlights.question: Why does the EBITDA of INR1,002M and 19% margin not reconcile with the analyst's own calculation, and what drives the rise in employee and outsourcing costs?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the gap relates to full-year items such as a CSR component and an indirect tax provision, which are one-offs; outsourcing costs rose as contractors were used instead of headcount. The team agreed to reconcile offline.

qa_highlights.question: What was organic growth in Q4?
qa_highlights.answer: Ex-acquisitions, Q4 growth was about 3% QoQ in dollar terms and about 2% YoY in constant currency and 3% in dollar terms (per the CEO's reply).

qa_highlights.question: What is the implied organic growth within the high single-digit FY27 guidance?
qa_highlights.answer: Management declined to split out organic versus inorganic and said the numbers are a conservative best estimate that could swing widely; it reiterated high single-digit overall, and later said it would be higher absent macro impact.

qa_highlights.question: Why is the Q1 FY27 guidance double-digit YoY while FY27 is only high single-digit, and what is the implied sequential growth?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said double-digit YoY is possible in Q1 as paused budgets return; the CFO guided low single-digit QoQ growth for the coming quarter.

qa_highlights.question: Is the contract tenure shrinking?
qa_highlights.answer: No shrinkage in contract tenures has been seen, and none is expected.

qa_highlights.question: What is the currency hedging approach and why are forex losses booked despite a weaker rupee?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO said hedges are taken for transfer pricing and the unhedged exposure drove the loss, which is MTM plus some realized; management said the policy is to protect margins and that currency benefits are generally retained.

qa_highlights.question: What is the ESOP dilution?
qa_highlights.answer: Vesting is typically 3 years with 4- to 5-year exercise windows; if all options were exercised, dilution would be about 1% each year.

risks_watch: Revenue miss versus expectations, driven by two large clients' year-end budget cuts; management says Q1 FY27 should recover, which needs to be tracked.
Guidance is less specific: high single-digit FY27 growth, 18-20% margin, and no quarterly guidance beyond Q1; management said it will refine each quarter.
Reconciliation of reported versus adjusted EBITDA: an analyst found a gap and the company has said it will respond offline.
Forex: unhedged exposure and MTM hedge losses continue to weigh on reported profit; the CFO said quarterly corrections will recur.
Integration and seasonality of SweetRush, which affects margins over about 6 quarters.
AI monetization is early: AI-enabled revenue is about 13% of the total; component pricing is still being validated with clients.
Management declined to quantify NRR and organic growth on the call, and the analyst pressed on both.
summary.management_tone: Confident on long-term AI positioning and client relationships, but cautious and defensive on near-term numbers: management called the guidance conservative, avoided quantifying NRR and organic growth, and deferred several reconciliation questions to offline follow-up.
key_quotes: I want to be direct, revenue came in below our expectations.
We view this as timing driven, not structural, and our ongoing engagement with both those clients confirms that view.
For FY '27, we expect the revenue to grow in high single digits, subject to the macroeconomic environment.
Traditionally, we have been a 20% margin company. And I don't see that changing in near future.
